main.description: Lets readers submit their own documents as replies to this one (pub.leaflet.interactions.reply) and shows the ones the author made visible (pub.leaflet.interactions.replyVisibility). Replies are resolved at render time rather than stored on the block.

buttonText.description: Label for the button readers use to submit a reply.

promptText.description: Text inviting readers to reply, shown beside the button.

showPublicationTheme.description: Render each reply in its own publication's theme. Defaults to true.

audience.description: Who may reply: anyone, only subscribers to the document's publication, only its paid members, only members of the tiers in tierIds, only accounts the author follows, or only accounts following the author. Defaults to anyone. Checked when a reply is submitted.

tierIds.description: Paid membership tier ids whose active members may reply when audience is tiers.

closesAt.description: When the block stops taking replies. Absent means it never closes. Checked when a reply is submitted.

key.description: Tells this block apart from the document's other blocks of its type; interaction records name it in their `block` field. Records without a matching key belong to the first block of the type.
